meta.name: flowkit
meta.description: Analyzes flow cytometry data with FlowKit, including spillover compensation, logicle and biexponential transforms, hierarchical gating, GatingML strategies, and supported FlowJo 10 workspaces. Use for reproducible gate counts, population percentages, gated fluorescence summaries, or reproducing a FlowJo analysis in Python. For FCS metadata inspection or file-format repair alone, use FlowIO.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把流式细胞仪原始数据做补偿与圈门,得到可复现的细胞比例和荧光统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做流式细胞术实验,想把分析流程跑成可复现的代码
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run flow cytometry experiments and want your gating analysis reproducible in code

howto.what: 用 FlowKit 分析流式细胞数据：做溢漏补偿、logicle 变换与层级门控，可套用 GatingML 策略或复现 FlowJo 10 工作区，产出各门的事件数与百分比、门内荧光汇总。
howto.when: 当你要求可复现的门控计数、群体百分比或复现 FlowJo 分析，或提到 GatingML 策略、工作区等时接管；只做 FCS 元数据检查或格式修复请用 FlowIO。

say.text: 用 Python 搭门控策略：先补偿，再做 logicle 变换和层级门控。
say.note: 可用 export_gml 导出 GatingML 模板。

howto.what_en: Analyzes cytometry data with FlowKit: spillover compensation, logicle transforms, hierarchical gating, running GatingML strategies or supported FlowJo 10 workspaces, and reporting gate counts, percentages, and fluorescence summaries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for reproducible gate counts, population percentages, or to reproduce a FlowJo analysis, or mention GatingML strategies or workspaces; use FlowIO for FCS metadata only.

say_en.text: Run this GatingML strategy on sample.fcs and report gate counts and percent.
Reproduce the Study group in study.wsp and give gated fluorescence summaries.
say_en.note: Supply every FCS file in the selected group.

say_en.text: Build a Python strategy: compensate, logicle transform, then hierarchical gates.
say_en.note: Exports a GatingML template via export_gml.
